purpose: Teach: 授与/保健所/延命/即答/一辺倒/疲弊/病名/早けれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、社員に表彰の授与を喜んでなさったぞ
lines.en: Your father — he took genuine pride in presenting those commendations to the founding staff.
lines.style: Measured, slightly distant, as if drawing from deep memory. Quiet satisfaction in the recollection. Slow cadence, each phrase deliberate. Eyes looking past the present moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは保健所への対応も誠実でした
lines.en: Yes. Father handled the health office's requirements with real integrity.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Listening more than speaking. Soft anchor on the word 'integrity' — not dwelling, just marking it. The tone of someone learning what to carry forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の延命と健康に投資なさった
lines.en: Your father invested in his people — in their longevity, in their health.
lines.style: Quiet, almost tender. A pause held before 'invested' — the weight of that choice. Slow, deliberate pacing. Faint trail-off, as if offering the memory forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの即答ぶり、見習っております
lines.en: Yes. The way Father gave answers without hesitation — I'm learning from that.
lines.style: Humble but grounded. A soft dip on 'learning' — not performative humility, genuine study. Even pace, respectful. The voice of someone taking on responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、利益一辺倒の経営はなさらなかった
lines.en: Your father never ran the business for profit alone.
lines.style: Firm and clear, but not harsh. A slight weight on 'never' — certainty without bitterness. Slow, measured. The voice of someone stating something true and lasting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員が疲弊しない経営を目指された
lines.en: Yes. Father aimed to build a business where his people wouldn't be ground down.
lines.style: Deeper register. A catch of emotion held in check. Deliberate, almost formal phrasing. The voice of someone understanding, step by step, what that choice cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、製品の病名表示にこだわった
lines.en: Your father cared deeply about honest labeling on the products — about naming the disease clearly.
lines.style: Precise, almost protective of the detail. The voice of someone who has learned why specificity matters. Slow. A faint emphasis on 'naming' — the ethics of clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。早ければ次世代に事業を継ぎます
lines.en: Yes. When the time comes — as soon as it can — I'll carry the business forward.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. No rush, no drama. A gentle firmness, like making a vow to someone no longer listening. Even pace. The closing note: grounded, steady, clear-eyed.
